Exploitability_explanation: Zappa provide integration with Django via zappa/ext/django_zappa.py (calling django.setup()). However, after a thorough search, no explicit calls to the vulnerable Django functions (e.g., order_by() for CVE-2021-35042 or FileResponse for CVE-2022-36359) were found in the Zappa codebase. Per the evidence mandate, without a call to the vulnerable API, exploitability is set to 1%.
